assessment.operation: Maintain balanced methionine-cycle flux so methionine availability, SAM-dependent methylation, homocysteine recycling and transsulfuration remain coordinated across changing physiological demand.

functional_dependency.statement: Glycine is the acceptor substrate of glycine N-methyltransferase, which consumes SAM and forms SAH and sarcosine during methyl-group handling.

dietary_supply.statement: Individual glycine composition in foods supports dietary supply of the same amino-acid substrate; no amount or increased flux is inferred.

targeted_searches.query: Glycine food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation
targeted_searches.outcome: Authoritative FAO individual-amino-acid composition supports qualitative meat sources; no quantity or increased methylation inferred.

assessment.assessment_limitations: Endogenous glycine synthesis and other methyltransferases also contribute. Enzyme loss is not glycine deficiency; extra dietary glycine has not been established to normalise whole-cycle or brain methylation.

assessment.operation: Maintain epithelial tight junction integrity and selective permeability at the gut lining.

functional_dependency.statement: Glutamine availability sustains epithelial junction-related cellular capacity; cell perturbations distinguish this from systemic inflammation.

dietary_supply.statement: The existing randomised oral-glutamine trial establishes delivery of the same identified amino acid. Food composition and ordinary-food intervention equivalence remain unresolved.

targeted_searches.query: Glutamine food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation
targeted_searches.outcome: Combined Glx and total-protein tables cannot establish glutamine-specific food composition. No unsupported food source is added.

assessment.assessment_limitations: Cell deprivation including endogenous-synthesis blockade is not ordinary human nutritional deficiency; culture exposure is not a food dose. Selected clinical population and supplemental free glutamine. Neither ordinary-food equivalence nor benefit in healthy people, brain function or ADHD is established.

assessment.operation: Adjust community substrate-processing capacity through resource competition and changes in microbial function.

functional_dependency.statement: Inulin supplies beta-(2,1)-linked fructan substrate to microbes with the corresponding utilisation machinery, supporting this glycan-processing capacity.

dietary_supply.statement: Oral long-chain inulin is a tested dietary exposure. Primary plant chain-length measurements independently support qualitative inulin source research; vegetable consumption has not been shown equivalent to the purified intervention.

targeted_searches.query: Inulin food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation
targeted_searches.outcome: Primary chain-length measurements support preparation-qualified chicory-root/Jerusalem-artichoke candidates. Generic fructan labels do not establish long-chain inulin.

assessment.assessment_limitations: Utilisation genes, chain length, alternative substrates and resident organisms constrain the response. A supplied inulin substrate is not an indispensable intake, a guaranteed abundance shift, butyrate yield, mucus effect or clinical benefit.

assessment.operation: Maintain gut-to-brain nerve signalling through the vagus nerve and enteric nervous system.

mechanism_engagement.statement: Linoleic acid engages intestinal fatty-acid sensing and vagal/brainstem nutrient signalling in the tested mouse circuits.

dietary_exposure.statement: The identified fatty acid is present in verified food-composition records and reaches intestinal sensing through lipid digestion. The direct classification concerns the fatty-acid sensing input, not a downstream metabolite or a claim that ordinary meals reproduce the 10% experimental exposure.

targeted_searches.query: Linoleic acid food composition, chemical form and preparation; distinguish tested formulation
targeted_searches.outcome: Retrieve existing structured linoleic-acid edges; free fatty-acid stimulus differs from esterified fatty acids in foods.

assessment.assessment_limitations: This is physiological nutrient sensing, not a beneficial direction or a need to increase linoleic acid. Human food-level circuit responses, vagal tone, ADHD and clinical benefits were not established. Foods generally supply esterified fatty acids released during digestion; the experimental free-fatty-acid stimulus is not a demonstrated food effect. More signalling is not automatically better.
